The '''Bracer computer''' was a powerful gauntlet [[Computer/Legends|computer]].<ref name="CWCG" />

==Characteristics==
The bracer computer was a high grade [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] worn on the user's forearm, and had roughly the same processing power as a stock [[5YQ-series protocol droid]].<ref name="CWCG" /> Able to perform all the functions of a standard datapad - including reading standard [[Datacard/Legends|datacard]] in a slot on the underside of the device - the bracer computer featured a [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] screen that displayed information as a two-dimensional image roughly three centimeters above the device.<ref name="CWCG" /> The bracer computer was popular among those who needed to conserve space with their equipment, and was especially easy to use as its keyboard was designed to accommodate one-handed typing, both features making it a favorite among [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]].<ref name="CWCG" />
